decisions.reason: This perfect binder is close to the firm's established finishing and service knowledge, but as a less differentiated offer beside a fully automatic variant it faces some rationalisation risk.

The fully automatic perfect binder matches the firm's stated direction toward automation and digital finishing, so its strong fit with existing capabilities makes continuation more likely than withdrawal.
The inline and nearline booklet maker fits the firm's core post-press portfolio and customer base in digital print, giving the firm good scope to learn, support, and improve it commercially.
